_doc: The strings the Dice Forge screen shows, and nothing else. It exists because X-04 requires every user-facing string to be a loc key in EN and DE from day one, and because ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences fails a loc key that nothing in the content set names — a key referenced only from C# is an orphan, and an orphan is fatal. This document is that naming. The upgrade names are the three the rules layer OFFERS (Rules.Dice.DiceForgeMenu): raise the pips, make it a Surge, make it a Fortune. Star and Chain are withheld — a Star face makes every later ROLL_DICE answer ILLEGAL_STATE, and nothing fires a chain's follow-up roll — and `block.withheld` is the sentence that says so. Deliberately absent: the six face names, which the Die Panel's document already carries.
